operations.label: Tn5 insertion with coupled DNA fragmentation and adapter tagging
operations.description: Adapter-loaded Tn5 acts on native chromatin, preferentially inserts in exposed genomic DNA, and simultaneously fragments and tags it. The insertion drawing shows this action; 'Fragmented and primed' is its product boundary, rather than an independently specified priming reaction.
operations.mechanism: Hyperactive Tn5 transfers its sequencing-adapter payload into accessible genomic DNA while fragmenting the DNA; steric hindrance lowers transposition probability in less accessible chromatin.
operations.information_effect: Insertion sites and the genomic DNA intervals between them preserve information about accessibility and chromatin packaging. Accessible locations preferentially yield amplifiable fragments; this does not establish perfect exclusion of protected regions or isolated nucleosome-free DNA.

operations.label: Purify DNA and amplify the tagged library
operations.description: The depicted 'DNA purification Amplification' block converts the fragmented chromatin preparation into purified, amplified genomic DNA library molecules. It remains one composite block; routine cleanup and amplification internals are not separately reconstructed.
operations.mechanism: The scoped standard 2013 preparation purifies the transposition products and PCR-amplifies library fragments using Nextera-compatible primers; the paper also reports library cleanup after PCR.
operations.information_effect: Amplification produces copies of tagged genomic inserts for sequencing while retaining their insertion-defined boundaries and lengths. Primer-compatible adapter arrangements and fragment spacing affect which molecules are amplified. The schematic ends at DNA and depicts no sequencing-data or analysis operation.

method_scopes.rationale: The card title and both assigned drawings identify ATAC-seq. The poster's middle ATAC-Seq row repeats the primary schematic; ORGANIC and THS-seq are neighboring separate rows, and the THS-seq T7-promoter/IVT branch is outside this target. The left assay overview and repeated 'Open DNA' show the starting chromatin, not an opening procedure. The Tn5 icon is an added catalyst/reagent, the insertion scene is the tagmentation action, 'Fragmented and primed' is its output, and the final block is 'DNA purification Amplification' to 'DNA'. The collection page heading also mentions Fast-ATAC, but its figure caption says 'A schematic overview of ATAC-seq'; that heading and catalogue adaptations do not expand the assigned 2013 scope. Primary text confirms the standard purification/PCR interface. The paper's separate low-cell-number shortcut, single-cell variants, and named catalogue kit links are not additional depicted routes.
